A '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]''' was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Trained in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], as part of her final trial she was sent was sent into the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] to retrieve the helm of [[Tulak Hord]], a task Harkun deemed impossible. Though the Zabrak survived where many other acolytes did not, she succumbed to madness and was unable to leave the Tomb. Eventually, she confronted another group of acolytes sent on the same errand. Though [[Lana Beniko]] initially persuaded her to leave by reciting the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith Code]], the Zabrak eventually struck anyway and killed a wounded acolyte [[Kagan]], before Beniko retaliated and ended her life.
